t: This is Devonshire Street, in the City of Westminster, running alongside Harley Street. It's known for the number of medical establishments it contains. The street takes its name from William Cavendish, the fifth Duke of Devonshire, a nobleman and politician who was Lord Lieutenant of Derbyshire and was made a Knight of the Garter in 1782. The politician Andrew Johnston, a Liberal, was born here. Beyond that, the street is best understood as part of the medical neighbourhood around you.
